title: Falsification of a literal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let a literal specify a coordinate $i\\in\\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and a required sign $s\\in\\{\\pm1\\}$, and let $\\rho$ assign each coordinate either no restriction or a fixed sign. The literal is falsified exactly when its coordinate is fixed to a sign different from $s$; a free coordinate does not falsify it.
